brief_title: Metformin for Reducing Metabolic Syndrome in T2DM Patients With CAD
eligibility_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:
- Type 2 diabetes mellitus diagnosis
- HbA1c between 6.5% and 9.5% within the last 3 months
- Age 30 to 75 years
- Documented coronary artery disease
- Patient able to make own informed decisions

Exclusion Criteria:
- History of drug abuse or substance use disorder
- Creatinine > 1.5 mg/dL at screening
- Use of dietary supplements within 2 months prior to enrollment
- Ketoacidosis within the past 1 year
- Active alcohol abuse

brief_title: Aspirin Dose Optimization in Diabetic Patients Post-MI
eligibility_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:
- Type 2 diabetes mellitus
- Myocardial infarction within the past 6 months
- Currently taking aspirin 81mg daily for MI prevention
- HbA1c > 7.0% at baseline
- Age >= 18 years

Exclusion Criteria:
- Drug abuse or illicit substance use in the past 2 years
- Creatinine > 2.0 mg/dL
- Alcohol abuse (> 14 drinks/week)

brief_title: Intensive Glycemic Control in Advanced CAD Patients
eligibility_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:
- Advanced coronary artery disease defined as at least 2 of the following: history of MI, coronary artery bypass graft surgery, percutaneous coronary intervention, or catheterization showing >= 50% stenosis
- HbA1c >= 7.5% and <= 10.0% within 3 months
- Major diabetes diagnosis (Type 1 or Type 2)
- English-speaking patient capable of giving informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:
- Creatinine > 2.5 mg/dL
- Drug abuse within the past 5 years
- Dietary supplements use in the past 2 months
- Ketoacidosis within the past year

brief_title: SGLT2 Inhibitor in Heart Failure With Preserved Ejection Fraction and T2DM
eligibility_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:
- Confirmed heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (EF >= 45%)
- Type 2 diabetes mellitus
- HbA1c between 6.5% and 11.0%
- Age >= 50 years
- Patient is able to make own medical decisions

Exclusion Criteria:
- Creatinine > 2.0 mg/dL or eGFR < 30 mL/min
- Active alcohol abuse
- Drug abuse in past 3 years
- Dietary supplements (omega-3, CoQ10, or similar) within 2 months

brief_title: Creatinine-Based CKD Progression in T2DM Patients on Metformin
eligibility_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:
- Type 2 diabetes mellitus
- Creatinine > 1.2 mg/dL (above upper limit of normal)
- HbA1c between 7.0% and 9.0% within 6 months
- Currently prescribed metformin
- Age 35 to 70 years

Exclusion Criteria:
- Creatinine > 3.0 mg/dL (advanced CKD)
- Drug or alcohol abuse
- Dietary supplements within 2 months
